PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday APRIL 9, 2020
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG
3. ROLL CALL: CHAIR NEMETH, VICE CHAIR AVERY, COMMISSIONERS FRENCH, HENDERSON, AND SMITH
PRESENT: Chair Nemeth, Vice Chair Avery, Commissioner French, Commissioner Henderson, and Commissioner Smith
ABSENT: None
4. REVIEW OF AGENDA
5. MOTION TO WAIVE FULL READING OF ALL RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA FOR THIS MEETING
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS AND ANY ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA
7. CONSENT CALENDAR APPROVAL OF MINUTES FROM THE REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING OF FEBRUARY 12, 2020
Minutes
8. PUBLIC HEARINGS
8A. Conditional Use Permit 17-008
Dani Abdulaziz, Applicant
(Continued from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of March 12, 2020)
A request by the Planning Commission to review the existing conditions and on-going operations of an amusement arcade known as Fish and Games located at 2550 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-012 revoking the Conditional Use Permit 17-008 based on the findings contained in the draft Resolution. (Staff Reference: Justin Sauder, Associate Planner)
8A 1st Part
8A 2nd Part
8B. Tentative Parcel Map 82361 / Variance 19-001 / Site Plan Review 19-008
WoodSpring Suites Hotels and Merlone Geier Partners, Applicants
A request to subdivide one parcel totaling approximately 16 acres into four commercial lots, reduce the required lot width for one parcel, and construct a four-story hotel with 123 rooms located at the southwest corner of Avenue Q and the Antelope Valley Freeway (State Route 14).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-017 approving Tentative Parcel Map 82361, Variance 19-001 and Site Plan Review 19-008, and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program, finding that the project will not result in a significant impact to the environment. (Staff Reference: Justin Sauder, Associate Planner)
TPM 82361 / Variance 19-001 / SPR 19-008
8C. Conditional Use Permit 19-017
Thanos Fitness, Applicant
A request to relocate and expand the existing fitness center use within an approximately 4,300 square foot tenant space within an existing commercial building located at 848 West Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-013 approving a fitness center use and find that the project is exempt from environmental review. (Staff Reference: Justin Sauder, Associate Planner)
CUP 19-017
8D. Conditional Use Permit 97-2 Major Modification No. 1 and Site Plan Review 20-002
Mr. Tim Hadaya, Applicant
A request to expand the interior of an existing convenience store, modify the building facade, and construct other minor upgrades to the site located at 1020 West Columbia Way (Mobil).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-015 approving Conditional Use Permit 97-2 Major Modification No. 1 and Site Plan Review 20-002 and find that the project is consistent with the previously approved Negative Declaration. (Staff Reference: Clarence "Skip" Smith, Assistant Planner)
CUP 97-2 MM No. 1 and SPR 20-002
8E. General Plan Amendment 18-003, Zone Change 18-003, Tentative Tract Maps 82174 and 82175, Planned Development 18-002, and Site Plan Review 18-006
Mr. Phillip Terry, Applicant
A request to construct a residential community consisting of apartments, triplexes, and single-family residences located at the northeast corner of Rancho Vista Boulevard and 20th Street West (APN's 3005-005-014, 3005-005-023, 3005-005-024 and 3005-005-025).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2020-014 recommending City Council approval of General Plan Amendment 18-003 and Zone Change 18-003, approve Tentative Tract Maps 82174 and 82175, Planned Development 18-002, and Site Plan Review 18-006 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared for the project. (Staff Reference: Megan Taggart, Senior Planner)
8E 1st Part
8E 2nd Part
